needs.what: The render scale setting is not available.
GPU timestamp reports are not per segment: a game that measures its GPU time may pick a wrong dynamic resolution.
The frame rate the game was tested at is not applied (nxnative writes the engine's frame limit or steps the game by the host's vsyncs); the game runs at its own rate.
Only 16:9 output: the game's taller-screen mode is not available.

cuts.why: lower bound of the candidate interval: fmov s0,s11 (2.0) → fmov s0,s10 (1.0)
lower bound of the candidate interval: cmp w27,#2 → cmp w27,#1
step-down target recorded when stepping up, max(candidate, w24) − 1: mov w24,#3 → mov w24,#2
step-down target recorded when stepping up: cmp w8,#3 → cmp w8,#2
stepping down stops at < 3 → at < 2: cmp w9,#3 → cmp w9,#2
interval controller always takes the GPU time path (CPU span timing): cbz x0,#0x1126934 → b #0x1126928
interval controller always takes the GPU time path (takes max(CPU span, GPU time)): cbz x0,#0x112698c → b #0x1126980
